title: Bakit Hindi Laging Full Power ang Panels?
audience: New solar owners checking their app
premise: Panel ratings come from standard test conditions (1000 W/m², 25°C cell). On real roofs panels run hotter, and heat lowers output; shade, dust and sun angle also reduce it, so actual output is normally below the rating.
scriptBasis: Claude draft from the 104-episode backlog title/angle, V1.1 brand lines; claims checked online 2026-11-24.

cards.title: Aktwal
lines: Sa bubong, normal na mas mababa

sources: Sources: NREL STC & PVWatts loss model; Penn State AE 868

cues.text: Bakit hindi umaabot sa rated watts ang panels mo?
Ang rating ay galing sa lab test: standard test conditions.
1000 W/m² na liwanag at 25°C na cell temperature.
cues.say: One thousand watts per square meter na liwanag, at twenty-five degrees na cell temperature.

cues.text: Sa totoong bubong, mas mainit ang panels,
at kapag mas mainit, bumababa ang output.
May epekto rin ang anino, alikabok, at anggulo ng araw.
Kaya normal na mas mababa ang aktwal kaysa rating.
Dahil ang gusto ni Kuya SoLight… naka-solar ka na, SoSmart ka pa!

claims.wording: Panel ratings come from standard test conditions: 1000 W/m² irradiance and 25°C cell temperature.
claims.caveats: STC also specifies AM1.5 spectrum (not named on screen).

claims.wording: Panels on real roofs run hotter than 25°C, and higher temperature lowers output.
claims.caveats: No percentage named; depends on temperature coefficient.

onlineCheck.note: Negative temperature coefficient of power (typ. −0.3 to −0.4 %/°C); rooftop cells usually exceed 25°C in sun.

caption.main:
Bakit hindi laging full power ang panels? Ang rating ay galing sa lab (STC: 1000 W/m², 25°C cell). Sa bubong, mas mainit ang panels, at may anino, alikabok at anggulo ng araw. Kaya normal na mas mababa ang aktwal. 🌡️☀️

SoSmart viewers, ano'ng peak output na nakita n'yo sa app? 👇
caption.short: Rated watts = lab result. Normal na mas mababa sa bubong. 🌡️
